blurb: Black Mountain Bowmen is a non-profit archery club established in 1949, located in San Jose, CA. The club maintains a 28-target NFAA 560 Field archery range open daily from 8:00 AM to sunset. The range is free to use by the public but closed during monthly maintenance work-parties and tournaments.
